annotations.title: Good Faith Effort Exception: does a request qualify?

description: Judges a request for apprentices under the Good Faith Effort Exception (26 CFR 1.45-8(f)(1)): a written request (electronic or registered mail) to a registered apprenticeship program covering the facility’s area and occupation, sent at least 45 days before the apprentices are needed (14 days for a later request to the same program), with the dates, occupation, location, number, expected hours, contact and a statement of intent to employ. Denied, or unanswered for 5 business days, it stands in for the apprentices for its period, up to 365 days (366 across a leap year). Returns the lead-time check, the response status, how long the exception runs and when to request again.

later_request_to_same_program.description: true if this is a later request to a program already asked once (14-day lead time instead of 45).

needed_from_date.description: When the apprentices were asked to start (YYYY-MM-DD): coverage runs from here.

needed_through_date.description: The last day of the employment period requested (YYYY-MM-DD), if the request named one.

received_date.description: When the program received it (YYYY-MM-DD), if different: the five business days run from receipt (1.45-8(f)(1)(i)(C)).

request_date.description: When the request was sent (YYYY-MM-DD): the send date for email, the delivery date on the receipt for registered mail.

response.description: The program’s answer so far (default none).

response_date.description: When the program answered (YYYY-MM-DD), if it did.

today.description: The date to judge from (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the response date or the request date.
